_readme: IMP-11. Exceptions to check-dead-machinery.mjs, each with a reason someone
can evaluate later. This is a record of decisions, not a mute button.
A reason beginning with 'KNOWN GAP' means the thing genuinely is not wired
up yet. Those are counted and reported separately on every run, so unfinished
work stays visible in the check's own output instead of being silenced by
being written down. Clear them by wiring the thing up, not by editing the
The gap count jumped on 2026-07-31. It was not a new outbreak: rule 1 was
counting TypeScript COMMENTS as callers and rule 3 could not fire at all.
Everything added that day was already in this state and invisible, and each
entry was checked against the live database before being written down.

uncalled_rpcs.is_visit_tech: Verified in the live database: used by the storage RLS policy 'assigned tech uploads visit photo files' on storage.objects. Policies from the consolidated bootstrap dump are not files in supabase/migrations, so the scanner cannot see them.
uncalled_rpcs.optimize_route_for_day: KNOWN GAP — granted to authenticated and called from nowhere. Route optimisation runs in the app today; this SQL implementation predates it and is either dead or an unfinished server-side path. Needs a decision: wire it up or drop it.
uncalled_rpcs.admin_generate_invoices_for_org: KNOWN GAP — retired but still granted to service_role. hooks/nightly.ts explains that run_billing_cycles replaced 'the old cadence-blind admin_generate_invoices_for_org sweep', and that comment was the only thing in src/ naming it — which is why the check passed it until TypeScript comments were stripped. Verified in the live database on 2026-07-31: the function exists and nothing references it (no policy, view, trigger, cron job or other function body). Drop it, or say why it is kept.
uncalled_rpcs.has_plan_entitlement: KNOWN GAP — the SQL mirror of PLAN_ENTITLEMENTS. tests/entitlement-parity.test.ts keeps it honest, but by parsing the migration's VALUES matrix as text, not by calling it; nothing else does either. So plan gating is enforced in TypeScript only and the database enforces none of it, which is the thing having a SQL mirror was supposed to fix. Verified in the live database on 2026-07-31: no policy, view, trigger or function body references it.
uncalled_rpcs.portal_resolve_contact: KNOWN GAP — retired and still granted to service_role. src/lib/portal-auth.server.ts resolves the contact with a direct service-role query instead 'so branding lives in code', and the sentence saying so was the only mention in src/. Its one remaining caller is tests/integration/portal-auth.db.test.ts, which is exactly the shape this check exists to catch: a test proves the machinery works when called, and says nothing about whether anything calls it. Verified in the live database on 2026-07-31: no other reference. Revoke and drop it.

endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/hooks/weekly-diges: pg_cron job 'weekly-digest', 0 13 * * 1 — created by 20260731130000, verified in cron.job.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/hooks/announcement: KNOWN GAP — no scheduler targets it, so an announcement marked send_email=true is never sent. Scheduling platform-wide outbound email is an owner decision, not a cleanup task.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/hooks/stripe.ts: Stripe Connect webhook endpoint. Called by Stripe on tenant payment events.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/hooks/platform-str: Stripe platform webhook endpoint, for HoundStack's own SaaS billing (bucket A).
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/hooks/qbo-callback: QuickBooks OAuth redirect target — the browser lands here after a tenant authorizes.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/leads.ts: Public lead-capture form, embedded on tenant websites. Called by a browser from outside the app.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/api/public/verify-email.ts: Target of the verification link in a signup email.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/email/auth/webhook.ts: Supabase Auth send-email hook — Supabase calls this to render auth mail.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/email/transactional/send.ts: Server-to-server send path, called by the app's own notification code rather than imported.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/email/unsubscribe.ts: Target of the List-Unsubscribe header and the footer link in every marketing email.
endpoint_callers.src/routes/email/suppression.ts: Provider bounce/complaint webhook — writes the suppression list.

write_only_columns.deepclean_charge_cents: KNOWN GAP — visits.deepclean_charge_cents. admin_generate_seasonal_deepcleans stamps each generated visit with the org's seasonal charge, and nothing ever reads it: not the invoicing path, not the app. is_deepclean IS read (the UI shows a 'Deep clean' chip), so the visit is marked as a deep clean and then billed as an ordinary one. Either the charge belongs in the invoice line or the column should go.
write_only_columns.invoice_line_item_id: KNOWN GAP — addon_charges.invoice_line_item_id. Set by admin_generate_invoice_for_client when an add-on is billed, so the charge points at the line it became, and nothing follows the pointer in either direction. Verified in the live database on 2026-07-31: one function mentions it, and that mention is the UPDATE that writes it.
write_only_columns.reversed_at: KNOWN GAP — franchise_adjustments.reversed_at, written by record_franchise_adjustment alongside status = 'reversed'. The settlement query filters on status, never on this timestamp, so when an adjustment was reversed is recorded and never asked. Harmless today; it is the BUG-24 shape (a fact recorded and ignored), so it is written down rather than assumed fine.
write_only_columns.reversed_by_adjustment_id: KNOWN GAP — franchise_adjustments.reversed_by_adjustment_id, the link from a reversed adjustment to the one that reversed it. Written by record_franchise_adjustment, read by nothing, so a statement cannot show which repayment cancelled which deduction — the audit trail exists in the table and not in any answer the system can give.
write_only_columns.signup_utm: KNOWN GAP — organizations.signup_utm. bootstrap_organization captures the signup UTM payload on every new tenant and nothing reads it: no report, no platform metric, no query. Attribution data collected since 2026-07-14 that no one can see. Either surface it or stop storing it — it is personal data with no purpose.
